benchmarks.name: VABench T2AV micro Visual QA

setup.version: VABench as released with arXiv:2512.09299v2 (6 Apr 2026), text-to-audio-video (T2AV) track, 778 samples
setup.metric: Micro-level Visual QA: for each sample, 3-7 human-verified questions about visual elements and physical action details in the prompt; an LLM judge marks each as satisfied or not; score = mean over samples of satisfied/asked (Eq. 2), 0-1.
setup.protocol: Each model generates one video per T2AV prompt with default frame rate/duration at 720P (VABench paper) or the evaluator's stated resolution; the VABench toolkit scores the output.
setup.limitations: Only the Visual QA column is used (one metric; the other 12 VABench metrics are correlated sub-scores of the same outputs and are not imported). Judge model not named in the extracted text. V+A pipelines (video model + separate audio model) are mapped only through the merged visual cells that belong to the video generator. I2AV track (Table 2) not used.

benchmarks.why_new: No VABench id exists. 8 catalogue models across two CC BY sources (VABench paper: sora-2, veo-3-fast, wan-2-5-preview, seedance-1-0-lite, wan-2-2-5b; Kandinsky 6.0 report: ltx-2-5, kandinsky-6-0-pro, kandinsky-6-0-lite).
